reason: The cited lines show the handler requests a browser screenshot via context.sendSocketMessage and returns the result as a PNG image. They do not show arbitrary host code execution. They also do not show agent-supplied data being sent to an attacker-readable destination; the only outgoing message is a fixed internal-looking socket command with an empty payload. The lines indicate data is returned from a browser screenshot, but they do not establish whether the captured browser content is non-public/credentialed data or attacker-controllable web content, so SECRET and UNTRUSTED are not settled by these lines alone.
